summary: JOSTEIN RØNNESTAD (org. no. 984 661 436) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Volda, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2002-07-09. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 01.500 (Kombinert husdyrhold og planteproduksjon); it has 0 registered employees.

gaps.reason: Legal form ENK is normally not required to file annual accounts in Norway, so none are public.
No website is registered in Enhetsregisteret or verified on Wikidata.
No LEI is registered with GLEIF for this organisation number (common for companies without traded securities or large financial contracts).
